title: Synthesis of C60-CM-Cn and its effect on the stabilization of nitrocellulose
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23827-23835
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01741F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Haoxi Chu, Bo Jin, Yang Zhao, Rufang Peng
The fullerene derivative C60-CM-Cn was synthesized via a two-step reaction using fullerene (C60), curcumin (C21H18O5), and bromoalkanes (RBr) as raw materials.
